name: Jinej fond
decision_note: Brno investment company of two entrepreneurs who say they are 'not a classic VC fund' and invest their own money in early-stage startups (e.g. HTG Medical follow-on, July 2026) - a private investor/angel vehicle, outside the VC pilot.

evidence.quote: Nejsme klasický VC fond, ale dva podnikatelé ( Honza & Jirka ) investující do fajn lidí s fajn nápady.
Baví nás inovativní firmy, projekty a startupy v jejich rozletových fázích.
Do financování se zapojily fondy Garage Angels, Electron Capital Partners a JIC Ventures i stávající investoři Jinej fond a Dendis Capital.
Startup nyní získal dalších 450 tisíc eur (zhruba 11 milionů korun) jako druhou část pre-seed investičního kola.

analyst_notes: Second-pass screen (existing investor in Garage Angels' HTG Medical deal). Despite the name, the site says it is not a classic VC fund but two entrepreneurs ('Honza & Jirka') investing in founders (e1); Jinej fond, s.r.o. (IČO 09259104, Brno, est. 2020) has two natural-person partners in ARES VR, consistent with that. Typed private_investor (own-capital vehicle of two angels; secondary angel) - S1. Activity: HTG Medical second pre-seed tranche, EUR 450k round total (Lupa 2026-07-14); Jinej's share not disclosed. Stage derived from 'rozletové fáze' and the HTG pre-seed round. The site is a one-page teaser without portfolio, sectors or ticket.
